desc: 吹塑内衬分格收纳的家用五金工具箱，锁扣提手便携、开箱即取
leaf: 家用五金工具套装（吹塑内衬分格收纳工具箱）
name: 吹塑内衬分格收纳工具箱款

shots.intent: 用开箱全貌在墨绿舞台与大理石展台上立住整套配齐的第一印象，抢详情页首屏停留
shots.textZone: 顶部居中主标题位＋上方一枚胶囊角标位

shots.intent: 给一张合规白底闭合箱体图，让买家看清提手与双锁扣的便携形态并满足平台白底位
先放大工具散装在抽屉里互相磕碰、要用的找不到的日常麻烦，让买家对上自己的处境
shots.textZone: 底部居中一枚标签胶囊位

shots.intent: 把闭箱放进家门玄关的日常检修语境，用脚边比例锚点证明提着就走、放得下
用前锁扣、后铰链与吹塑合模缝的微距仰视证明壳体与五金件的做工
shots.textZone: 底部墨绿色带内一个标题位

shots.intent: 以 90 度正俯视的吹塑型腔阵列讲清一格一具的收纳结构与防震逻辑
shots.textZone: 型腔组两侧各一个短标签位

shots.intent: 用两栏规格表与长宽高引线消掉装不装得下、放不放得进门边柜的疑虑
shots.textZone: 左上两栏规格标签位＋三条长宽高引线标签位

shots.intent: 左右同框同机位对照纸箱散装与一格一具的差别，把收纳结构变成可见结果
shots.textZone: 左右分屏下沿各一个标签位

shots.intent: 沿用源图金线白卡编号模块，用金属面与握柄包覆的中景特写坐实材质与工艺
shots.textZone: 卡内左下一枚描边编号圆牌位＋主标题位与一行副标题位

shots.intent: 用同一墨绿圆角卡上的细线图标宫格与空白徽牌承载可核验要点，降解决策风险而不编造资质
shots.textZone: 宫格上方一个标题位＋每枚图标下一枚空白徽牌位

shots.intent: 以灰色标本座与留白按钮收口，把开箱全貌压在最后一屏引导下单
shots.textZone: 上方一枚香槟描边按钮位＋其下一枚空白徽牌位

style.backgroundSystem: two alternating fields only: a deep bottle-green seamless stage #1B4536 for the opening, module and closing screens, and a bright field of pale marble #F1EFEA or seamless white #FFFFFF for the packshot, structure, spec and comparison screens; the green stage carries at most two out-of-focus monstera leaves at opposite corners and one rounded card plate in the same green; never a black or charcoal stage
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight hairline circle badges in champagne #D6BC84 with one simple line glyph each, laid out in a 3x2 grid, one deliberately empty plaque reserved under every badge; a hairline-outlined white rounded card with a champagne border is the only content frame
style.lightingSystem: neutral-cool 5500K soft diffused key from the upper left with a white fill card, broad soft shadows, one honest contact shadow under the case, one thin specular line along polished metal edges only, no hotspots, no coloured gels; the single lifestyle screen switches to daylight from an open door on the left
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium hardware-tool-kit ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep bottle-green stage #1B4536, pale marble #F1EFEA and seamless white #FFFFFF as the base fields with one champagne hairline accent #D6BC85; neutral-cool 5500K soft diffused key light from the upper left with a white fill card, broad soft shadows, one honest contact shadow under the case and one thin specular line along polished metal edges only; bright fields and the bottle-green stage alternate screen by screen, the green stage carrying at most two out-of-focus monstera leaves at opposite corners, never a black or charcoal stage; pale marble block #F1EFEA as the main riser, warm micro-cement floor #E6E1D8 for the single lifestyle screen and a grey micro-cement specimen plinth #6F7073 for the closing screen; modern geometric sans-serif for Chinese and Latin, one family only, Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」, one headline plus one pill badge plus two or three short labels per screen; thin single-weight hairline circle badges in champagne #D6BC84 in a 3x2 grid, each above one deliberately empty plaque, and a champagne hairline-framed white rounded card as the only content frame; the product is always a rectangular blow-moulded carry case with a rear-hinged lid, two front latches, an integrated top handle and a moulded cavity tray, every tool seated in its own cavity; stable product scale, centred placement and the same slight 3/4 hero angle across the opening, lifestyle and closing screens; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no legible brand wordmark or printed digits, no invented figures where a blank plaque is reserved.
noDrift: no black or charcoal stage screens
no loose tools outside their moulded cavity
no legible brand wordmark, model code, printed digits or tape-measure numbers
no rendered figures instead of blank plaques
style.presentationRules: the subject always reads as a rectangular blow-moulded carry case with a rear-hinged lid, two front latches, an integrated top handle and a moulded cavity tray; every tool stays seated in its own cavity and never loose; hero slight 3/4 angle repeated across the opening, lifestyle and closing screens; stable product scale and centred placement
style.surfaceSystem: pale white marble block #F1EFEA as the main riser, seamless white #FFFFFF for the compliance packshot, warm micro-cement floor #E6E1D8 for the lifestyle screen, grey micro-cement specimen plinth #6F7073 with a chamfered corner for the closing screen
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for Chinese and Latin, one family only; one headline plus one pill badge plus two or three short labels per screen, Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」, one thin champagne rule as the only divider, no dense body copy, all figures left as blank plaques
